+"""KinDER standard-mode episode driver for instance i00.
+
+Run from /app with the simulator service available. Actions are sent only through
+the documented rcb_client interface; this file is kept alongside the episode.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def save_image(path, image):
+    from PIL import Image
+    Image.fromarray(image).save(path)
+
+
+def observe(robot, cameras=None, depth=False):
+    return robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="frames")
+
+
+def move(robot, delta, gripper=0.0, steps=1, camera="robot_wrist"):
+    """Repeat a bounded delta command for the requested number of 10 Hz steps."""
+    row = np.asarray(list(delta) + [float(gripper)], dtype=np.float32)
+    if row.shape != (11,):
+        raise ValueError("delta must contain base x/y/yaw and seven arm joint deltas")
+    actions = np.repeat(row[None, :], int(steps), axis=0)
+    return robot.submit("delta", actions, cameras=[camera], video="none")
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+    obs = observe(robot, cameras=list(spec["cameras"]), depth=True)
+    for name, image in obs.last.items():
+        save_image(OUT / f"initial_{name}.png", image)
+    print(json.dumps({"spec": spec, "status": robot.status()}, indent=2))
+
+    # The task is controlled interactively after inspecting the initial sensors.
+    # Keep this entry point as the auditable, documented client for the run.
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
